changelog:
Initial release: Programmatically publish all major post types to a LinkedIn Company Page using the versioned REST Posts API.

- Supports text, single-image (with required alt text), multi-image carousel, video (single and multipart), and article link preview posts.
- Handles LinkedIn’s full three-step (sometimes four-step for video) media upload and processing flow automatically.
- Bundles both a Python CLI and an importable Python library for flexible integration.
- Requires only environment variable configuration—no extra config files.
- Includes CLI helper for OAuth token acquisition and comprehensive troubleshooting references.
- Documents API limitations and clarifies unsupported LinkedIn features.
